FIELDS.NAME: Emergency Response Ambulance Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Emergency Response Ambulance Services provides critical emergency medical transport to hospitals and trauma centers, operating with a team of certified EMTs and paramedics. Our operations include 24/7 dispatch and response capabilities, ensuring immediate assistance for medical emergencies. We maintain a fleet of ambulances that are regularly inspected and serviced according to manufacturer guidelines to ensure safety and reliability. Compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations is paramount, reflecting our commitment to regulatory standards and patient care. To enhance our service quality, we have established protocols for incident reporting and continuous training for our staff to uphold high medical response standards. Additionally, we ensure all patient transports and dispatch records are accurately maintained to facilitate compliance and quality control.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities such as offering ancillary services like body piercing, pharmacy dispensing, or cosmetic procedures. We confirm that all patients are transported to a hospital emergency room, and we maintain current, valid certifications and licenses for all EMTs and paramedics. Additionally, we have established a formal quality assurance program and incident reporting system to ensure the highest standards of service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, we incurred a loss of $5,000 when one of our ambulance vehicles was damaged due to a collision while responding to an emergency call, which resulted in a claim that was successfully settled. On 09/10/2022, there was another incident involving a patient fall during transport that resulted in a claim for $7,000; this claim is currently pending resolution.
